description: Record a sourcing requirement with VOLT48 on behalf of a buyer (telecom operator, ISP, integrator, data-centre team): part numbers or descriptions with quantities. VOLT48 is selecting its manufacturing partners; the request is recorded and quoted once a supplying factory is confirmed. Nothing is binding and nothing is sent automatically. It registers the buyer's contact details with VOLT48.
